description: Full multi-source label cascade for one ETH wallet. Returns labels from several third-party label providers and the heuristic classifier with per-source attribution and a consensus entity/type. Source provider_e covers addresses that are, control or funded Polymarket wallets (category pm_wallet / pm_owner / pm_funder, with n_wallets, volume_usd, realized_pnl_usd, top_wallet and its public name) and mass payers of those wallets (bridge, exchange, batch_sender, campaign, pm_rewards_payer, ...), with basis onchain_fact or behaviour_inferred / behaviour_corroborated (a guess from behaviour) and evidence; it answers for an address on any EVM chain, and never feeds the consensus. found is true when any source knows the address. Use when the user asks 'what do you know about this address', 'who labeled this wallet' or 'is this a Polymarket trader'.
name: wallet_label_provenance
title: Wallet Label Provenance
